title: CAM
description:
REC. GEAR UP. GET OUT.CAM: Extraction is a tactical extraction shooter seen entirely through a bodycam. Grainy VHS footage, fisheye lens, raw sound - every raid feels like leaked footage from an operation gone wrong.

Pick your loadout, drop into a hostile building, search it for loot and make it to an extraction zone before the clock runs out. Make it out and everything you carried is yours. Go down and it's gone.

PLAY TOGETHERInvite up to 3 friends through Steam and raid as a squad. Cover corners, split up to loot faster, drag the team out when things go bad - or go in alone if you trust nobody.

ENEMIES THAT THINKThe AI does not stand still and wait. Enemy squads react to gunshots and footsteps, call in nearby allies, flank from the sides, hold angles, crouch behind cover, fall back to heal and push when you are reloading. Every shot you fire tells them where you are.

KEY FEATURES• Bodycam perspective - realistic head-mounted camera with VHS noise, lens distortion and sharpening for that found-footage look.

• Extraction loop - raid, loot, extract, sell, upgrade. Your stash and credits carry between raids.

• Co-op up to 4 players - host a party and invite friends straight from Steam.

• Tactical AI - flanking, suppressing, healing and sound-based hunting.

• 3 raid locations - Building, School and Hospital, each packed with enemies and lootable containers.

• Timed raids - get to an extraction zone and hold your ground to get out before time runs out.

• Trader and loadouts - buy weapons, ammo, armor and meds, then build the kit you bring into the next raid.

• Full graphics settings - Lumen on or off, per-feature quality, resolution scale, FPS limit and more.

EARLY ACCESSCAM: Extraction is in active development. More maps, weapons, enemy types and progression are on the way, shaped by what you tell us. Jump in, hit record, and let us know what you think.
description_short: CAM: Extraction is a co-op bodycam extraction shooter. Drop into hostile buildings with up to 3 friends, outsmart AI squads that flank and hunt you by sound, grab what loot you can carry and reach the exit alive. Die in there and you lose everything you brought.
